objective: Build, test and hand off a responsive Leave Request form (capstone) as a Draft PR.

allowed: feature branches of the allowed repository

acceptanceCriteria: Form validates dates, reason length, 30-day maximum and overlap with approved leave
Loading, error (with retry), empty and success states are all handled
Fully keyboard operable with visible focus and announced errors
One component test and one browser flow test pass locally
nonGoals: No changes to existing days or screens
